summary: Add an accessible inline editor that initializes from a selected task, validates its title, saves all editable task fields through existing state persistence, and supports cancellation.
steps: Add editing state and save/cancel handlers to the task list.
Render accessible inline controls for all editable task fields.
Style the edit action and responsive inline editor consistently with Daymark.
Add automated coverage for save, validation, cancellation, and persistence.
Run deterministic and browser evaluations, then record the harness report.
risks: Replacing a list item's display with a form could affect list semantics or existing controls.
Date/category filters may move an edited task out of the current view after save.
Browser storage assertions must wait for the React persistence effect.
